page.notes: Doubtful readings: "se-" at the line end (possibly "fe-"; the context suggests "sequi"). "veru-steper" at the line end is unclear: the word is probably "veteres", but the letters do not match, so it is flagged. "rectoribus" is read from the context; the letters are unclear. "cur,bat" shows a printed comma inside the word, as the scan shows it. "quodres est" and "Sicille" are printed without spaces and are kept as printed. "indict.13." in note e is uncertain. The italic/roman boundary in the quotation from Gregory (e) is uncertain.
